brief: Inspects a text holding Ring source: spots functions and classes, lists their names, counts lines of code, and can run it.
detail: Build one with new stzStringCode(cSource). The inspection works line by line on the text and never changes it: FunctionNames, ClassNames, NumberOfFunctions, NumberOfClasses, ContainsFunctions, ContainsClasses, LinesOfCode, IsComment and IsBlankLine. IsRingCode is a guess by keyword substring and gives false positives on prose. Execute and ExecuteAndReturn run the text with eval: only give them code you trust, and note that a variable assigned by Execute stays inside the call.
receiver: o1 = new stzStringCode("func Add(a, b)" + char(10) + " return a + b" + char(10) + "# note" + char(10) + "class Pt")
